text_block_list.text:
One day, as training for the Make Debut 
was in full swing—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ha— Yaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Phew!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-chan, that was amazing!" "With a 
run like that, no one can beat you!" 
"You're definitely gonna win your Debut 
race too!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... thank you for cheering me on! 
I'll keep up this momentum for my Make 
Debut too!

"At the center of that circle is Buena 
Vista. Like Red Desire, she is an 
Umamusume poised to make her Debut soon—a 
'classmate' of hers."

Her incredible talent and innocent, bright 
personality have captivated everyone 
around her.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista... she really is amazing. 
She's completely overwhelming in this 
generation.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
"Seems like there's no one who can stand 
against you. As expected of the 
'Next-Generation Heroine'!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...The next generation's... heroine. 
...You too, Buena-san...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying you're a chosen one as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If the world insists on calling her a 
heroine, then I must lay the truth bare.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Our roles in the story of this world— 
mine, and yours!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"It pains me to put you to the test like 
this... Buena-san. Allow me to see the way 
you live your life with my own eyes."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You lost your necklace? What does it look 
like? I'll help you look for it.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I'm fine, really! I can look for it 
on my own!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll be faster if we search 
together. It'll be much harder to find 
once it gets dark... So, won't you let me 
help?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Yes... of course Buena-san would do 
that...)

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Thank you, Buena-chan...! It's a 
necklace with an antique-ish design, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm... Yeah, got it! All right, we're 
definitely gonna find it!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"To just stand by and watch Buena and the 
others like this...――"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Something that must never happen to a 
Saint—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Please wait.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Desire-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I shall lend you my sacred power as well. 
I will certainly guide the lost item back 
to its owner."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Having you with me makes me feel so 
much better, Desire-chan. Let's split up 
and look!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Even after searching this much, to not 
even find a single clue...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(No, I must never give up. O Light, please 
guide me—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah―― Something just shone!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(It shone...? No way... Was Buena-san 
being guided...?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes, here you go. Is this the right 
necklace?

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's my necklace...! T-Thank 
goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm truly glad. That's a horseshoe 
motif, isn't it? It's lovely."

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, you see... this is a keepsake 
from my grandma. Whenever training gets 
tough, it always cheers me up."

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: So... thank you both so, so much!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Is that what happened...? Her 
grandmother's... keepsake...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad we found what's precious to 
you... *sniff*. I'm really, truly so 
glad...

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: B-Buena-chan!? P-Please don't cry~……!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Such beautiful tears... Proof of a pure 
heart...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Besides... Buena-san said, "I saw the 
light"... A light that I wasn't able to 
feel today—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for searching with me. For 
rushing over to help... hehe, I'm glad you 
did.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: No, I only did what was natural.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I was watching. Watching you. Watching 
what you did.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"In order to discern the true essence... 
of you, who are hailed as the heroine of 
the next generation."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... I see! Since we'll be running 
together a lot from now on, you were 
gathering data on me, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're so admirable, Desire-chan. I'd love 
to get to know even more about you from 
now on.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Right! After all, we debuted at the same 
time, which makes us rivals running in the 
same generation, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You know, seeing how hard Desire-chan 
works always gives me so much energy. 
She's so earnest and single-minded... It 
makes me want to work even harder, too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I'll train hard, get stronger... and win 
no matter what. Against you... against 
anyone! I won't lose!"

text_block_list.name: Buena's Friends
text_block_list.text: Buena-chaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...There are plenty of girls who want to 
talk to you, aren't there?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Have a safe trip, Buena-san. I have 
successfully accomplished my objective.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh... Y-Yeah. See you later, Desire-chan!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Right. ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah, Buena-san, you're—...!?

Red Desire told me that she had "something 
important to discuss." Wondering what it 
could be, I hurried to our meeting spot—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san was none other than the 
'absolute heroine' beloved by this very 
world!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
By observing Buena-san up close and 
interacting with her... I finally 
understood.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Anyone would be drawn to Buena-san's 
pure, beautiful spirit—unable to help but 
love her."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even the world itself loves her, giving 
her light and blessing her...— Yes, to the 
point where even I am moved to tears!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is no exaggeration to say that the 
script of this world revolves around her.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"If not an 'absolute heroine,' then what 
else could you possibly call her……!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The way Buena-san carries herself... is 
just like the heroine of this novel."

Watching Red Desire speak with such 
fervent passion as she praised Buena 
Vista, a slight flicker of anxiety crossed 
my mind.
choice_data_list:
(Could it be that she's totally won over 
by Buena?)

(Could it be that she's totally won over 
by Buena?)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —However!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It simply means that the heroine of this 
world happened to be Buena-san!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
As someone who also seeks to shine in this 
"Other World," she is without a doubt 
someone I must surpass—my greatest 
trial...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
As long as you are being tested in this 
world, you will face comparisons and 
perhaps even unfair treatment.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, you fall short in nothing, and 
there is no reason for you to feel 
inferior.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
For I am one who will truly shine only in 
"that land." The destination I must reach 
lies far beyond the horizon!

Faced with such a powerful discourse and 
that burning gaze, I couldn't help but be 
struck with admiration.

While acknowledging Buena Vista's 
greatness, she still believes without a 
shadow of a doubt that she is special.
choice_data_list:
You haven't lost your confidence, have 
you?

It's not like you've lost your confidence, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there is no way I could lose it. —No 
matter what happens, I am the protagonist 
of my own story.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is the one-and-only protagonist 
shining in their own story— that is an 
unshakable truth!

Red Desire will not falter. All that's 
left is to hone her strength enough to go 
toe-to-toe with Buena Vista.

"First, I must claim a victory in the 
fast-approaching Make a Debut—!"
